preFixDirectObservation.serverFact: Spring logged Failure in ApiErrorHandler.coverError caused by HttpMediaTypeNotAcceptableException: No acceptable representation

rootCause: TripCoverException denial was correct and immediate, but its Map error body had no explicit JSON content type. Android's Accept: image/jpeg made Spring reject JSON error serialization; the Python helper's single catch obscured this response-negotiation/framing failure.
fix: ApiErrorHandler.coverError now explicitly sets Content-Type application/json while preserving status, privacy code, Cache-Control no-store and Pragma no-cache.
